mapper.select: SELECT map.class_key AS classKey, uc.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_class_unit_map map JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON map.unit_key = uc.unit_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_time_table (yy, mm, dayname, period_no, start_time, end_time, class_key, unit_key, grade_key, user_code, created_at, time_table_key, center_code) values (#{yy}, #{mm}, #{dayname}, #{periodNo}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{gradeKey}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME(), #{timeTableKey}, #{centerCode});
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_time_table SET yy = #{dto.yy}, mm = #{dto.mm}, dayname = #{dto.dayname}, period_no = #{dto.periodNo}, start_time = #{dto.startTime}, end_time = #{dto.endTime}, class_key = #{dto.classKey}, unit_key = #{dto.unitKey}, grade_key = #{dto.gradeKey}, user_code = #{dto.userCode}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} AND cc.class_type = (SELECT cc2.class_type FROM erp_time_table t2 JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t2.class_key = cc2.class_key WHERE t2.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey})

SELECT t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, c.class_type AS classType, c.class_key AS classKey, t.center_code AS centerCode, t.user_code AS userCode, cf.fee AS classFee, max(CASE WHEN c.class_type = '1' THEN eta.han_material_fee WHEN c.class_type = '2' THEN eta.book_material_fee END) AS bookFee
FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON c.class_key = CASE WHEN t.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta.class_key ELSE t.class_key END LEFT JOIN erp_class_fee_map_copy cf ON cf.class_key = c.class_key AND cf.center_code = t.center_code AND cf.category = CASE WHEN s.is_hoho = '1' THEN 'hoho' WHEN s.is_hoho = '0' AND c.class_type = '1' THEN 'han' WHEN s.is_hoho = '0' AND c.class_type = '2' THEN 'book' END LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign eta ON ta.student_id = eta.student_id WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND ta.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY t.time_table_key, c.class_type, c.class_key, t.center_code, t.user_code, cf.fee;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_attendance (student_id, attendance_key, time_table_key, center_code, week, yy, mm, created_at) SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id, 'before' AS attendance_key, #{timeTableKey} AS time_table_key, #{centerCode} AS center_code, w.week AS week, #{yy} AS yy, #{mm} AS mm, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS created_at FROM (VALUES ('ju_1'), ('ju_2'), ('ju_3'), ('ju_4')) AS w(week) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = w.week);

INSERT INTO erp_monthly_score (question1, question2, question3, question4, question5, question6, question7, question8, student_id, yy, mm, time_table_key, created_at) VALUES (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, #{studentId}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{timeTableKey}, SYSDATETIME());
mapper.select:
Select a.* from ( -- 입회 Select 'entry' as gb, es.student_name, a.* from (Select student_id, Case WHEN han_state = 1 Then (Select c.class_name + ',' from erp_class_code c where c.class_key = t.assign_han_class) else '' end + Case WHEN book_state = 1 Then (Select c.class_name + ' ' from erp_class_code c where c.class_key = t.assign_book_class) else ' ' end className, null as 'week' from erp_teacher_assign t where (assign_han_teacher = #{userCode} and substring(entry_han_date, 1, 7) = #{ym}) or (assign_book_teacher = #{userCode} and substring(entry_book_date, 1, 7) = #{ym})) a Join erp_student es On a.student_id = es.student_id
UNION ALL
-- 탈퇴 Select 'inactive' as gb, es.student_name, a.* from (SELECT student_id, null as className, null as week FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{userCode} = 'all' OR inactive_han_teacher = #{userCode}) AND substring(inactive_han_date, 1, 7) = #{ym} UNION ALL SELECT student_id, null, null FROM erp_teacher_assign WHERE (#{userCode} = 'all' OR inactive_book_teacher = #{userCode}) AND substring(inactive_book_date, 1, 7) = #{ym}) a Join erp_student es On a.student_id = es.student_id
UNION ALL
Select 'move_in' as gb, es.student_name, a.* from (Select student_id, class = (Select c.class_name from erp_class_code c where c.class_key = t.class_key), null as 'week' from erp_student_transfer_history t where to_user_code = #{userCode} and substring(move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym}) a Join erp_student es On a.student_id = es.student_id
UNION ALL
-- 전출 Select 'move_out' as gb, es.student_name, a.* from (Select student_id, class = (Select c.class_name from erp_class_code c where c.class_key = t.class_key), null as 'week' from erp_student_transfer_history t where from_user_code = #{userCode} and substring(move_at, 1, 7) = #{ym}) a Join erp_student es On a.student_id = es.student_id
UNION ALL -- 주(1,2,3) Select 'week' as gb, es.student_name, a.* from (Select etta.student_id, className = (Select c.class_name from erp_class_code c where c.class_key = a.class_key), '(' + etta.week + '주)' as 'week'
from (Select class_key, time_table_key from erp_time_table where yy + '-' + mm = #{ym} and user_code = #{userCode}) a Join erp_time_table_assign etta On a.time_table_key = etta.time_table_key where etta.week in (1, 2, 3)) a Join erp_student es On a.student_id = es.student_id) a Order by a.gb, a.student_name

SELECT time_table_key AS timeTableKey, period_no AS periodNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, dayname AS dayname, tt.class_key AS classKey, tt.unit_key AS unitKey, cc.class_type AS classType, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, G.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName FROM erp_time_table tt LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY dayname, period_no

SELECT ta.time_table_key, s.student_id, s.student_name, ta.week FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = ta.student_id WHERE ta.time_table_key IN
#{key}

SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, tta.week AS week, gc.grade_name AS gradeName FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_student st ON tta.student_id = st.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code gc ON st.grade_key = gc.grade_key WHERE tta.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} ORDER BY st.student_name

SELECT tt.id as timeTableId, tt.time_table_key as timeTableKey, tt.period_no as periodNo, tt.start_time as startTime, tt.end_time as endTime, tt.yy as yy, tt.mm as mm, tt.dayname as dayname, cc.class_name as className, uc.unit_name as unitName, g.grade_name as gradeName FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE tt LEFT JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key LEFT JOIN erp_user u ON tt.user_code = u.user_code WHERE tt.yy = #{year} and tt.mm = #{month} and tt.period_no = #{periodNo} and tt.dayname = #{dayname} and tt.user_code = #{userCode}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, ta.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, ta.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON ta.class_key = c.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON ta.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.class_key = 'COM'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, s.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, ta.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, ta.unit_key AS unitKey, uc.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_student s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_class_code c ON ta.class_key = c.class_key LEFT JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON ta.unit_key = uc.unit_key WHERE t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.class_key = 'COM'

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, s.app_token AS appToken, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_ym AS ym, t.class_key AS classKey, t.unit_key AS unitKey, sa.week AS week, sa.in_time AS inTime, sa.out_time AS outTime, ac.attendance_name AS attendanceName, ac.attendance_key AS attendanceKey, sa.is_before_send AS isBeforeSend, sa.is_after_send AS isAfterSend, rem.absence_date AS absenceDate, rem.remedial_date AS remedialDate, rem.updated_at AS updatedAt, s.center_code AS centerCode, ranked.remark_name AS remarkName FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign tta ON s.student_id = tta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON tta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_student_attendance sa ON s.student_id = sa.student_id AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = #{week} JOIN erp_attendance_code ac ON sa.attendance_key = ac.attendance_key LEFT JOIN erp_remedial rem ON s.student_id = rem.student_id AND rem.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND rem.week = #{week} LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr.student_id, rc.remark_name, rc.remark_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sr.student_id, rc.remark_category ORDER BY rc.id ) AS rn FROM erp_student_remark sr JOIN erp_remark_code rc ON sr.remark_key = rc.remark_key WHERE sr.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sr.week = #{week}) ranked ON s.student_id = ranked.student_id AND ranked.rn = 1 WHERE tta.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}

SELECT CASE #{week} WHEN 'ju_1' THEN bc.ju_1 WHEN 'ju_2' THEN bc.ju_2 WHEN 'ju_3' THEN bc.ju_3 WHEN 'ju_4' THEN bc.ju_4 ELSE bc.ju_1 END AS content, bc.before_class_key AS beforeClassKey, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_label AS timeTableLabel, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_before_class bc JOIN erp_time_table t ON bc.class_key = t.class_key AND bc.unit_key = t.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key WHERE t.unit_key = #{unitKey} AND t.class_key = #{classKey} AND t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND RIGHT (bc.before_class_key , 2) = #{yy}

select after_class_key AS afterClassKey, content, word, time_table_key AS timeTableKey, dayname AS timeTableLabel, u.user_name AS userName, review AS review, counsel_content AS counselContent, counsel_type AS counselType from erp_after_class_notice acn join erp_user u on acn.user_code = u.user_code where acn.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} and acn.student_id = #{studentId} and acn.week = #{week}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_remedial SET action = #{action}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
UPDATE erp_remedial SET remedial_date = #{remedialDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
UPDATE erp_remedial SET s_time = #{startTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, s.app_token, t.time_table_key, mr.feedback, mr.bottom_comment, mr.is_send, ms.question1, ms.question2, ms.question3, ms.question4, ms.question5, ms.question6, ms.question7, ms.question8 FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_score ms ON ms.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND ms.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_result mr ON mr.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND mr.student_id = ta.student_id WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_score SET question1 = #{score.question1}, question2 = #{score.question2}, question3 = #{score.question3}, question4 = #{score.question4}, question5 = #{score.question5}, question6 = #{score.question6}, question7 = #{score.question7}, question8 = #{score.question8}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.select: WITH base AS (SELECT s.student_id, s.yy, s.mm, s.time_table_key, t.class_key, t.unit_key, question1, question2, question3, question4, question5, question6, question7, question8 FROM erp_monthly_score s JOIN erp_time_table t ON s.time_table_key = t.time_table_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.yy = #{yy} AND s.mm = #{mm} AND s.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}), merged AS (SELECT f.correct_ment, CASE WHEN f.number = 1 THEN b.question1 WHEN f.number = 2 THEN b.question2 WHEN f.number = 3 THEN b.question3 WHEN f.number = 4 THEN b.question4 WHEN f.number = 5 THEN b.question5 WHEN f.number = 6 THEN b.question6 WHEN f.number = 7 THEN b.question7 WHEN f.number = 8 THEN b.question8 END AS score FROM base b JOIN erp_monthly_feedback f ON f.yy = b.yy AND f.class_key = b.class_key AND f.unit_key = b.unit_key) SELECT correct_ment FROM merged WHERE score = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_monthly_result (top_comment, bottom_comment, feedback, is_send, yy, mm, student_id, time_table_key, created_at) VALUES (#{topComment}, #{bottomComment}, #{feedback}, #{isSend}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{student.studentId}, #{timeTable.timeTableKey}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_result SET top_comment = #{topComment}, bottom_comment = #{bottomComment}, feedback = #{feedback}, updated_at = SYSDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}

WHEN ms.question4 = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS part4, CASE WHEN ms.question5 = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS part5, CASE WHEN ms.question6 = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS part6, CASE WHEN ms.question7 = 1 THEN THEN mf.competency END), '') AS part2_title, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 3 THEN mf.competency END), '') AS part3_title, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 4 THEN mf.competency END), '') AS '') AS part1_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 2 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part2_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 3 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part3_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 4 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part4_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 5 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part5_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 6 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part6_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 7 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part7_level, ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN mf.number = 8 THEN mf.difficultly END), '') AS part8_level, ISNULL(MAX(mr.bottom_comment), '') AS review, ISNULL(MAX(mr.feedback), '') AS partnote, ISNULL(MAX(mr.top_comment), '') AS class_contents, ISNULL(MAX(mr.bottom_comment), '') AS result_contents, '' as sdate FROM erp_monthly_result mr JOIN erp_time_table t ON mr.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_monthly_score ms ON mr.student_id = ms.student_id AND mr.time_table_key = ms.time_table_key JOIN erp_monthly_feedback mf ON mf.class_key = t.class_key AND mf.yy = mr.yy JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key AND mf.class_key = cc.class_key WHERE mr.is_send = '1' AND mr.student_id = #{id} AND mr.yy = LEFT (#{ym} , 4) AND mr.mm = RIGHT (#{ym} , 2) AND cc.class_type = CASE #{gb} WHEN 'S' THEN '1' WHEN 'I' THEN '2' END GROUP BY ms.question1, ms.question2, ms.question3, ms.question4, SELECT CASE c.class_type WHEN '1' THEN 'S' WHEN '2' THEN 'I' ELSE c.class_type END AS gubun, CASE t.dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN '월' WHEN 'tue' THEN '화' WHEN 'wed' THEN '수' WHEN 'thu' THEN '목' WHEN 'fri' THEN '금' WHEN 'sat' THEN '토' WHEN 'sun' THEN '일' ELSE t.dayname END AS dayname, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.start_time, 108), ':', '') AS stime, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR (5), t.end_time, 108), ':', '') AS etime, t.mm, c.class_name + ' ' + u.unit_name AS note FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON t.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE ta.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm}
order by stime ASC

INSERT INTO erp_before_class_notice(student_id, time_table_key, week, dayname, class_time, class_date, class_type, class_label, content, user_code, created_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{timeTableKey}, #{week}, #{dayname}, #{classTime}, #{classDate}, #{classType}, #{classLabel}, #{content}, #{userCode}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.update: MERGE erp_after_class_notice AS T USING ( SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id, #{timeTableKey} AS time_table_key, #{week} AS week ) AS S ON ( T.student_id = S.student_id AND T.time_table_key = S.time_table_key AND T.week = S.week ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.content = #{content}, T.word = #{word}, T.review = #{review}, T.class_type = #{classType}, T.class_label = #{classLabel}, T.dayname = #{dayname}, T.counsel_content=#{counselContent}, T.counsel_type=#{counselType}, T.updated_at = GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( student_id , user_code , time_table_key , after_class_key , yy , mm , week , dayname , content , word , review , class_type , class_label , counsel_content , counsel_type , created_at ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{userCode}, #{timeTableKey}, #{afterClassKey}, #{year}, #{month}, #{week}, #{dayname}, #{content}, #{word}, #{review}, #{classType}, #{classLabel}, #{counselContent}, #{counselType}, GETDATE() );
mapper.select: SELECT TOP(#{count}) class_type AS gubun, class_label AS note, CASE dayname WHEN 'mon' THEN '월' WHEN 'tue' THEN '화' WHEN 'wed' THEN '수' WHEN 'thu' THEN '목' WHEN 'fri' THEN '금' WHEN 'sat' THEN '토' WHEN 'sun' THEN '일' ELSE dayname END AS dayname, class_date AS ymd, class_time AS studytime, content AS prequest FROM erp_before_class_notice WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;

SELECT class_type AS gubun, class_label AS title, dayname AS dayname, week AS ju, yy AS yyyy, mm AS mm, content AS snote FROM erp_after_class_notice WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC;
SELECT * FROM erp_unit_code where unit_type = 'peo'
SELECT * FROM erp_class_code WHERE class_key NOT IN ('BSA', 'K', 'M') AND class_type = '2'
SELECT * FROM erp_unit_code WHERE unit_type = 'lv'

SELECT c.class_key AS classKey, t.user_code AS teacherCode, c.class_type AS classType FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND t.center_code = #{centerCode}

select b.title, a.study_date as sdate from (Select * from erp_book_clinic_study_log where yy + mm = #{ym} and study_type = 'T' and student_id = #{studentId}) a Join erp_book_clinic b On a.bcode = b.bcode Order by a.study_date, b.title

SELECT remark_key AS remarksKey, remark_name AS itemName, CASE remark_category WHEN 1 THEN '수업 준비' WHEN 2 THEN '수업태도' WHEN 3 THEN '이해도' END AS categoryName, remark_subject AS remarkSubject FROM erp_remark_code ORDER BY remark_category, id
